items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: when I knew Joe Oliver was coming through there

ctx.x: Edmund Hall was telling me that story how he had to talk to Cootie Williams' mother. Cootie lived in Mobile, and Edmund was from down New Orleans, see, and how he had to talk to his mother to get her -- get them to let Cootie down there and play for him. When I worked with Edmund with Louis he was talking about this story.
And they'd come through there. Joe Oliver would come through Savannah. But Joe Oliver -- when I knew Joe Oliver was coming through there -- Louis wasn't with Joe Oliver at that particular time.
When Joe Oliver came to Savannah that you saw him, what year would that have been? Around what year?
